sites.name: BURROWS SANITATION

facts.summary: EPA's site profile places the Burrows Sanitation site in Hartford, Michigan.
facts.reference: EPA CUMULIS site profile, Burrows Sanitation
facts.quote: The Burrows Sanitation site is located in Hartford, Michigan.

facts.summary: Plating sludges, waste coolants and oils were disposed of at the site from 1970 to 1977, contaminating groundwater, surface water, soils, sediments and lagoons. The page gives a span, so no single event date is recorded.
facts.reference: EPA CUMULIS site profile, Burrows Sanitation
facts.quote: Disposal of plating sludges, waste coolants and oils took place at the site from 1970 to 1977.

facts.summary: EPA's profile says operations and maintenance activities continue after cleanup. The fetched page does not give the SWRAU or NPL deletion date.
facts.reference: EPA CUMULIS site profile, Burrows Sanitation
facts.quote: Following cleanup, operations and maintenance activities are ongoing.

gaps: No Van Buren County assessor, GIS, recorder or treasurer portal was opened.
Batch address is a PLSS description ('ME1/4 SEC10 R16W T3S'), so no parcel match is possible from the address; the parcel would need to come from county GIS using the coordinates.
NPL deletion (2015) and the 2008 SWRAU date appear only in search snippets. The Federal Register page redirected to an unblock page and was not read, so neither is recorded as a fact.
Acreage conflict: EPA notices (per a search snippet) describe about 10 acres; a local news report describes about 15 acres; batch record shows 12.8 acres. Not resolved.

No Wyandotte city assessor, permit or code-enforcement portal opened. Batch acreage 25.6 not checked.

sites.name: DSC MCLOUTH STEEL GIBRALTAR PLANT

portals.name: Wayne County Treasurer Property Tax Listing System
portals.note: Opened. Address or Parcel ID search; lookup is free; covers Gibraltar as a Wayne County municipality. No owner-name search. Parcel ID not in batch, so search by address (28000 West Jefferson Street).

facts.summary: Planet Detroit reports the city council passed a one-year data center moratorium on a Monday; the article is dated 2026-03-11. Exact vote date not given; likely 2026-03-09.
facts.authority: City of Gibraltar council (as reported by Planet Detroit)
facts.reference: Planet Detroit, 'Gibraltar passes data center moratorium: Facility proposed at former McLouth Steel site' (2026-03-11)
facts.quote: hit a potential roadblock on Monday when the city council passed a one-year data center moratorium

facts.summary: Planet Detroit reports a proposed 100 MW data center at the former McLouth Steel site in Gibraltar.
facts.reference: Planet Detroit, 'Gibraltar passes data center moratorium' (2026-03-11)
facts.quote: A proposed 100-megawatt data center at the former McLouth Steel site in Gibraltar

facts.summary: The developer plans a utility substation and equipment on the adjacent Superfund property. The article says the developer does not intend to fully remediate that adjacent Superfund site.
facts.reference: Planet Detroit, 'Gibraltar passes data center moratorium' (2026-03-11)
facts.quote: The developer intends to locate a utility substation and some equipment on the adjacent Superfund property

gaps: No Gibraltar city assessor, planning or permit record opened; no deed, lien or tax record checked. No parcel ID in the batch.
Wayne County Register of Deeds not opened.
EPA listing history (2015 NPL listing, 2016 interim remedy, 2021 IIJA funding) appears only in search snippets from EPA documents that were not opened; not recorded.
Acreage conflict: EPA describes 620 acres in a search snippet; batch record shows 651.4 acres.
The article's date and the moratorium's exact vote date are approximate; the facts above use 2026-03.
